items.source: qualifiedTableName - the fully qualified name of the table this path is tied to or of the longest ancestor path that is actually tied to a table. Must not be null.
items.translation: qualifiedTableName - 此路径绑定到的表的完全限定名称，或实际绑定到表的最高级祖先路径的完全限定名称。不得为 null。

items.source: tableAlias - the alias used for the table on which this path is based. May be null.
items.translation: tableAlias - 此路径所基于的表的别名。可为 null。

items.source: backReferenceColumnInfos - information about the columns used to reference back to the owning entity. Must not be null. Since 3.5.
items.translation: backReferenceColumnInfos - 用于反向引用所属实体的列信息。不能为 null。自 3.5 版本起。

items.source: qualifierColumnInfo - the column used for the list index or map key of the leaf property of this path. May be null.
items.translation: qualifierColumnInfo - 用于此路径的叶属性的列表索引或映射键的列。可为 null。

items.source: qualifierColumnType - the type of the qualifier column of the leaf property of this path or null if this is not applicable. May be null.
items.translation: qualifierColumnType - 此路径中叶属性限定列的类型，若不适用于此情况则为 null。可为 null。

items.source: idColumnInfos - the column name of the id column of the ancestor path that represents an actual table. Must not be null.
items.translation: idColumnInfos - 表示实际表的祖先路径中 id 列的列名。不能为 null。
